FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh regeneration sac
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A regeneration sac woven from hive nerves and twisted flesh. Injured fleshbeasts crawl inside, where warm, viscous flesh fluid closes their wounds and repairs their carapaces. It works only on fleshbeasts and cannot be used to heal other creatures.
